statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // .model.id // "unknown"'); effort=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // "n/a"'); context_tokens=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // empty'); used=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); transcript=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); session_tokens=0; [ -r "$transcript" ] && session_tokens=$(jq -s '[.[] | .message.usage? | select(.) | ((.input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) + (.output_tokens // 0))] | add // 0' "$transcript" 2>/dev/null); fmt_tokens() { awk -v n="$1" 'BEGIN { suffix=""; v=n; if (n >= 999950000) { v=n/1000000000; suffix="b" } else if (n >= 999950) { v=n/1000000; suffix="m" } else if (n >= 1000) { v=n/1000; suffix="k" } if (suffix == "") { printf "%.0f", v } else { s=sprintf("%.1f", v); sub("[.]0$", "", s); printf "%s%s", s, suffix } }'; }; [ -n "$context_tokens" ] && [ -n "$used" ] && context_display=$(fmt_tokens "$context_tokens") && session_display=$(fmt_tokens "${session_tokens:-0}") && printf '%s | effort:%s | ctx:%s tokens (%.0f%% used) | session:%s tokens' "$model" "$effort" "$context_display" "$used" "$session_display"
